scope: is there any clear entry point, and do the regressions still hold

clear_investigation.method: walked every @deepseek-ai package in the installed build (js, md and json, three levels deep) and searched for /clear, /new, /reset, clearSession, session/clear, clearHist and resetSession, plus the command registrations themselves
clear_investigation.clear_command: absent - there is no clear or reset command to type on any surface

every_needle_hit_explained.goals/clear: clears the goal, not the conversation
every_needle_hit_explained.session/new (ACP docs): an ACP protocol method that creates a session; it is not a /clear alias and the executor did not substitute `new` for clear

clear_investigation.conclusion: no entry point and no documented equivalent exists on this build. This is stated as a fact about the build, not as an inference from a missing package name: the registration list itself is the evidence

regressions_this_round.bridge_credential_handoff_and_metadata: 26 passed, 0 failed - including 'host-metadata bridge rejects a first call without valid metadata' and 'unconfigured metadata bridge never falls back to its bootstrap credential after observing metadata', which is the fail-closed property this adapter now relies on

why_the_bridge_tests_matter_here: the DeepSeek overlay now declares TSUNAGOU_HOST_META_KEY, so this adapter is served by the same metadata routing the OpenCode path uses. Those tests are the evidence that the routing refuses rather than falling back
